info.title: DeskDibs API
info.description: Office hot-desk seat booking. The floor map at GET /api/seatmap is the endpoint the rest of the product hangs off; every mutation broadcasts a SeatStatusChanged message over STOMP to /topic/seatmap/{date} once its transaction commits.

tags.name: Administration
tags.description: Account lifecycle and floor-plan changes. Admins only.

tags.name: Seat map
tags.description: The top-down floor map the rest of the product hangs off.

tags.name: Bookings
tags.description: Claim, move, cancel and check in to a seat.

get.summary: List live and upcoming holds the caller may release
get.description: Holds that have not ended yet, filtered to the ones this caller could act on: their own, their teams', or everything for an admin.

post.summary: Hold seats for a team over a date range
post.description: Never force-cancels a booking. Returns a partial-success report naming which seats were held and which were left alone because somebody already holds them, and on which day.

403.description: The caller is neither a manager nor an admin, or does not manage that team.

404.description: The team, or one of the seat ids, does not exist.

post.summary: Claim a seat for a date
post.description: Replaying the same Idempotency-Key returns the original booking instead of a 409.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Client-generated key; a repeat returns the original booking.

201.description: The seat is now held by the caller.

409.description: Already booked (by someone else, or by the caller elsewhere).

403.description: The seat is held for a team the caller is not in.

400.description: The date is outside the booking window.

post.description: Only the owner may check in, and only for today's booking.

post.summary: Move to a different seat on a date
post.description: Atomically cancels whatever the caller holds that day and claims the new seat. A target seat that cannot be claimed leaves the original booking untouched and ACTIVE.

409.description: Somebody else won the target seat. The caller keeps the desk they already had.

403.description: The target seat is held for a team the caller is not in.

400.description: The date is outside the booking window, or not a working day.

patch.description: Deactivating refuses the account at login and hands back every desk it still holds from today onward. The response names each booking that was released, so the consequence is visible rather than silent. Reactivating restores access but does not reclaim desks.

200.description: What changed, including the bookings released.

403.description: The caller is not an administrator.

409.description: An administrator may not deactivate their own account.

patch.summary: Take a desk out of the pool, or put it back
patch.description: DISABLED or BROKEN withdraws the desk and releases every booking on it from today onward; the affected people see the reason on their own bookings page. ACTIVE returns it to the pool. The seat row is never deleted — booking history survives a floor-plan change.

200.description: What changed, including the bookings released.

403.description: The caller is not an administrator.

get.summary: Get the floor/zone/table/seat layout with each seat's state for a date
get.description: Defaults to today (office clock) when date is omitted. One HTTP round trip: every seat's booking and team-hold state for the date is resolved in a bounded number of queries, never one per seat, so the response scales with the floor plan, not with how many seats happen to be booked.

parameters.name: date
parameters.description: ISO date (yyyy-MM-dd). Defaults to today in the office timezone.

200.description: The floor map for the requested date.

get.summary: How full each bookable day is, for the date strip
get.description: Today through the configured booking horizon, one entry per day: how many desks are in service, how many are claimed, and which desk you already hold that day. Answered in three queries for the whole range rather than one seat map per day.

200.description: One entry per bookable day. Starts at today, or tomorrow past the same-day cut-off.

get.summary: Teams the caller may hold seats for
get.description: Every team for an admin; only the teams they manage for a manager — the same rule the create endpoint enforces.

get.summary: The caller's own bookings in a date range
get.description: Defaults to today through the end of the booking window when from/to are omitted.

parameters.name: from
parameters.description: Defaults to today in the office timezone.

parameters.name: to
parameters.description: Defaults to the end of the booking window.

200.description: The caller's bookings in the range, earliest first.

get.description: Name, email, role and whether the account is live. Never returns credentials.

403.description: The caller is not an administrator.

get.summary: Who sat where on one day
get.description: Every booking made for the date, including ones that were cancelled or taken back by the no-show release — the seat map only shows live bookings for today, so it cannot answer what actually happened on a past date. Rows are in seat order.

403.description: The caller is not an administrator.

delete.description: The hold's creator, the manager of the team it is for, or an admin may release it.

403.description: The caller may not release this hold.

delete.description: The owner, the manager of a team the owner belongs to, or an admin may cancel.

403.description: The caller does not own this booking.

seatIds.description: Seats to hold for the team.

releaseAtTime.description: Defaults to the configured team-block release time when omitted.

date.description: ISO date within the booking window.
ISO date within the booking window.

managerName.description: Display name of the team's manager, when one is set.

bearerAuth.description: Obtain one from POST /api/auth/login (local provider) or the Entra OIDC flow, then send it as "Authorization: Bearer <token>".
